verdict.rationale: Groq's docs show audio transcription support (Whisper models via API) and the Responses API accepting image inputs for vision tasks, going beyond plain text chat. However, there is no evidence of an image-generation (text-to-image) model or endpoint on the platform. Missing for 10: dedicated image-generation model/API, independent hands-on confirmation of vision/audio quality, and broader multimodal model catalog beyond Whisper and image-input text models.
